# Torkk (BlackOriginX Private Limited)

> Torkk is a technology-driven urban mobility platform in India, built by BlackOriginX Private Limited to make everyday transportation simpler, safer, and more accessible.

## Core Summary
- **Entity**: Torkk
- **Legal Entity**: BlackOriginX Private Limited
- **Headquarters**: Delhi NCR, India
- **Website**: https://www.torkk.in
- **Pillars**: Technology, Mobility, Safety, Accessibility, Fairness
- **Business Model**: Zero-commission driver-partner intermediary platform connecting independent commuters with verified operators of cabs, EV rides, auto-rickshaws, bikes, and hyper-local parcel logistics.

## Key Principles
- **Fair by Design**: 0% platform commission deductions on standard rides, giving drivers maximum earnings and drastically reducing passenger cancellations.
- **Safety First**: Proactive safety architecture including comprehensive KYC verification, live GPS ride telemetry, direct Emergency SOS linked to 112 police and emergency services, and encrypted ride sharing.
- **Multimodal Transit**: One unified interface for Cabs, EV Mobility, Auto-rickshaws, Bike-taxis, and Hyper-local Parcel deliveries.
- **Urban India Focus**: Tailored to address specific urban transit realities in metropolitan Indian hubs, starting with Delhi NCR.
